changelog: FIX (CRITICAL — v1.44.123 killed users on launch): v1.44.123's granular boot marks revealed 12 users in 24 hours ALL dying at the same line: `app_oc_post_crashhandler`. The migration call's first-access SharedPreferences lazy-load (reading app_mode_prefs.xml from disk) blocked the main thread long enough on Fire Stick eMMC that the ANR watchdog fired and SIGKILL'd the process before the activity could attach. v1.44.124 moves the migration OFF the main thread into the deferred init HandlerThread. MainActivity's UNSET → DeviceCapability.detect() fallback (added in v123) means fresh-install users get the right Lite UI on the very first frame even before migration completes. Pro→Lite migration applies ~100ms later via the reactive StateFlow.

FIX: MainActivity.isLite UNSET fallback now defaults to LITE on any failure path (was Pro). Safer for a TV stick of any kind — Pro UI mounting was what killed weak Fire Sticks, so when in doubt err on Lite. Users on capable hardware can always toggle back to Pro in Settings → App Mode.
FIX (v523): Fresh-install Fire Stick crash loop fix — migration now also fires for UNSET (was PRO only).
PERF (v523): All non-critical onCreate work moved off main thread.
DIAGNOSTIC (v523): 9 granular boot marks + app_mode + migration_state in every report.
FIX (v522): Removed AMAZON from premium-brand bypass — Fire Sticks now correctly auto-route to Lite.
MIGRATION (v522): One-shot silent Pro→Lite migration for existing Fire Stick users.
DIAGNOSTIC (v521): NEW BootPhaseTracker for ALL API levels.
FIX (v519): Memory-trimmed Pro mode for 1 GB Fire Sticks.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v516): 4 Movie/Series crashes on weak Fire Sticks.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' instant takes effect.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
